Attached: 1 image

H on any email in Roost and it leaves the inbox until later. Press 3 for tomorrow at 8, or type the time the way you'd say it: "fri 3pm", "in 2 hours", "next week". When it's due, it comes back to the top.

It's all kept on the Mac, so it works the same for Zoho, iCloud and Yandex as it does for Gmail.

https://roostmail.app/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_campaign=reply-later

#Productivity #macOS #MacApps #Email #IndieDev
